# GET/EXTSTATE and SET/EXTSTATE round trip
# Format: EXTSTATE \t section \t key \t value  (value empty string if unset)

# request: GET/EXTSTATE/streamdeck_test/foo   (key never set)
EXTSTATE	streamdeck_test	foo

# request: SET/EXTSTATE/streamdeck_test/foo/bar123
# (no response body)

# request: GET/EXTSTATE/streamdeck_test/foo
EXTSTATE	streamdeck_test	foo	bar123

# request: SET/EXTSTATE/streamdeck_test/foo2/hello%20world   (urlencoded value with space)
# request: GET/EXTSTATE/streamdeck_test/foo2
EXTSTATE	streamdeck_test	foo2	hello world
